title: Fun but don’t know if there will be more
body: I feel like this game takes advantage of players by encouraging them to spend real money to progress, without being transparent about whether new areas or additional content will actually be released. It’s frustrating to invest time and money into a game, only to reach a point where there’s nothing left to do and no clear information about when—or if—the game will expand. Players shouldn’t have to spend money on a game when there’s no guarantee that the content will continue. If the developers don’t plan to release more levels or areas, they should be upfront about it instead of encouraging people to keep investing. I enjoy the game, but the lack of transparency makes the spending aspect feel misleading. I would strongly recommend thinking twice before making in-app purchases until the developers provide clear information about future updates.

Recently one of the updates made it so that you’re unable to trash any of the tool items, even if they’re just pieces and not the full leveled up item. This leads to a lot of wasted space on the game board. I’m constantly running out of space and not being able to get rid of items is annoying. There’s also the issue that some of the bubbles you get after merging an item, can be purchased or you can watch an ad. This is nice, except the ad button replaces the trash button. So your only option is the watch the ad or wait until the time runs out for this item to go away. Again, when you’re low on space, this is an issue. The powerups are very difficult to get in the game. I’ve probably gotten less than five total the whole time I’ve been playing, which is super uncommon in a game like this. Having the scissors be more likely to show up would be really helpful. There are also four or five pop ups every single time you open the app trying to get you to buy something, which in a game advertised to children, I find pretty insidious. Things I do like, are the general gameplay, the storylines, and the character development. It’s nothing complex but it’s enough to be entertaining. The events are fun and keep me coming back. I like the different items that you unlock and the overall design of the app. The art style is fun and it’s an easy game to play.
